query:
SELECT 
  saleType,
  COUNT(*) as qtd_vendas,
  SUM(finalAmount) as total_vendas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN finalAmount ELSE 0 END) as total_cancelado,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'CANCELLED' THEN finalAmount ELSE 0 END) as total_ativo
FROM sales
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(saleDate, '%Y-%m') = '2026-01'
GROUP BY saleType
ORDER BY saleType;
